extractors.category: Penn State scab-resistant apple varieties for Pennsylvania home orchards

rows.name: Pristine
rows.description: Very early medium-sized yellow apple with pleasant tart flavor and a smooth attractive finish. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust moderate, powdery mildew resistant, fire blight moderate

rows.name: Williams Pride
rows.description: Early dark red-purple apple with large fruit and semi-tart flavor. Source notes it sometimes shows water-core or bitter pit. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew moderate, fire blight resistant to moderate

rows.name: Redfreed
rows.description: Early red-skinned sweet summer apple that is crisp but does not have a long storage life. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew resistant to moderate, fire blight resistant to moderate

rows.name: Crimson Crispc
rows.description: Rich flavor with moderately acidic and spicy aftertaste, bright red fruit, and cream-colored flesh. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust moderate, powdery mildew moderate, fire blight susceptible

rows.name: Libertyd
rows.description: Mid-season high-quality dessert apple that the source describes as most disease resistant. Flavor improves after storage. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew resistant, fire blight resistant

rows.name: Freedom
rows.description: Mid-season large apple with spicy flavor, rough external appearance, variable fruit quality, and susceptibility to black rot. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew resistant, fire blight resistant to moderate

rows.name: Jonafree
rows.description: Mid-season firm red apple, slightly tart and similar to Jonathan. Flavor improves after storage. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust susceptible, powdery mildew resistant, fire blight moderate

rows.name: Scarlet O'Harac
rows.description: Large round fruit with medium red to orange color and rich pleasant slightly spicy flavor. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew moderate, fire blight susceptible

rows.name: Sundancec
rows.description: Medium-sized fruit with sweet tart flavor and yellow fruit with some russet. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew moderate, fire blight resistant

rows.name: Enterprised
rows.description: Good-quality late-season smooth glossy red apple similar to McIntosh. Stores well but source notes susceptibility to a fruit spotting disorder. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust resistant, powdery mildew moderate, fire blight resistant

rows.name: Goldrushd
rows.description: Excellent-quality good-storage apple, very late maturing Golden Delicious type, with fruit that may russet. Disease ratings: cedar apple rust susceptible, powdery mildew resistant, fire blight moderate
